name: Philippians
author: The apostle Paul.
date: Usually dated about AD 60 to 62, from prison.
setting: Written to a loved and generous church in Philippi.
theme: Christ is our joy, our example, and our goal.

outline.label: Chains and the advance of the gospel
Rejoice and think on these things

christInBook: The hymn in 2:6-11 is one of the clearest statements of Christ’s humility, incarnation, death, and exaltation. Paul says that to live is Christ and to die is gain (1:21).
howToRead: Philippians is a letter of joy written from prison. Count how many times “joy” and “rejoice” appear. Notice how Paul ties humility and unity to the example of Christ.
